verdict.rationale: Clerk is an authentication and user-management platform, not an agent or AI client that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it is outside its product category. The MCP evidence concerns other roles: Clerk publishes its own MCP server, acts as an OAuth authorization server for MCP clients, and gates eve tool calls. None of that shows Clerk itself connecting to MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
